URI Honors offers students an opportunity to engage in advanced coursework, thought-provoking project work/dialogue, and more.  One defining moment of your Honors journey is participation in our inspiring yearly Colloquium. The URI Honors Program brings in amazing guest speakers, including scientists, bestselling authors, actors, politicians, activists, and other incredible leaders. Past students have met legends like Jane Goodall, actor B.D. Wong, and countless other changemakers. To learn more about our Honors Students and the URI Honors Program, check out our website and YouTube channel. If you’d like to be considered for the URI Honors Program, please submit a brief statement responding to the prompt below. In 250 words or less, please tell us:
What theme would you pick for your Colloquium? To guide you through your statement, consider answering the following questions within your writing:
Why does this theme matter to you personally?
Why would this topic grab the attention of other high schoolers and URI students?
What makes this theme super relevant to what’s happening in the world today?
Get creative and think about it—we’re excited to see what ideas you come up with!
